title: Best So Far
prompt: times (race results) is given. Print the fastest (smallest) time using a best-so-far loop — no min().

tests.name: prints 9.8
tests.code:
assert printed == ["9.8"], f"got {printed}"
assert "min(" not in code, "track the best with an if, no min()"
tests.hint: best = None; if best is None or t < best: best = t
